verdict.rationale: The models page documents a versioned ID (jev-1.13.0) alongside the jev-latest and jev-preview aliases. It defines the alias policy: jev-latest is the most recent stable release and the SDK default. It also tells developers to pin a version ID if they have tuned thresholds against it, and the response's model field reports the versioned ID that answered. All requests go through one endpoint, where the model field selects the model. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of pinning behavior, and a documented deprecation/retirement policy for pinned versions.
